limitations: Tests establish only tiny FP32 CPU agreement and first-order VJP; higher-order support and large-tree FP32 errors remain unqualified.
B is the specified eight-iteration approximate projected-dual algorithm, not a convergence claim.
52 allocated scalars are matched; effective capacity is not established (four older-ANA zero-input weights; source contrast rank at most five).
No real-tile memory, runtime, CUDA, fitting or utility evidence was collected; first actual TRAIN update must qualify feasibility and counts within160.
Frozen TRAIN baseline predictions are in-sample rather than OOF, and two development VAL parents are reused.
Local confidence-dependent calibration is possible in both arms; useful interleaving requires superiority over matched blocked.
No novel primitive, posterior, recurrent carry or node-age ancestry mechanism is claimed.

import json,hashlib,time,traceback,copy,types
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import arggnn.interleaved_tree_tv_gnn_v1 as op
from arggnn.persistence_trace_kernel_v1 import MetricTreeHoldV1
torch.set_num_threads(1);torch.manual_seed(737)
root=Path("/workspace-SR003.nfs2/ARG-GNN")
paths=["src/arggnn/interleaved_tree_tv_gnn_v1.py","src/arggnn/train_interleaved_tree_tv_gnn_v1.py","configs/interleaved_tree_tv_gnn_v1.json"]
r={"scope":"independent tiny FP32 CPU only","source_hashes":{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
   "actual_data_or_fit_or_GPU":False,"cuda_context_initialized":torch.cuda.is_initialized()}
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 ages=torch.tensor([0.,0.,100.,150.,400.,450.,200.,250.,500.,600.,900.],dtype=torch.float64)
 def tree(parent):
  return MetricTreeHoldV1(torch.tensor(parent),ages.clone(),torch.full((11,),-1,dtype=torch.long),
    None,torch.arange(6),torch.arange(6))
 t0=tree([6,7,6,7,9,9,8,8,10,10,-1]);t1=tree([7,6,6,7,9,9,8,8,10,10,-1])
 spans=torch.tensor([[0.,800.],[800.,900.],[900.,2000.]],dtype=torch.float64)
 positions=torch.tensor([100.,300.,600.,1100.,1400.,1900.],dtype=torch.float64)
 q=torch.tensor([0,1]);refs=torch.tensor([2,3,4,5]);classes=torch.tensor([0,1,2,3])
 bank=op.prepare_interleaved_tree_tv_bank_v1([t0,t1,t1],spans,positions,q,refs,classes,
   sample_identity_namespace="independent_tiny")
 block=bank.blocks[0];n=len(block.parent);Q=len(block.query_nodes)
 assert n<100 and Q==12
 children=(block.parent>=0).nonzero().flatten();parents=block.parent[children]
 # An independent dense FP32 Laplacian and differentiable solve, not the
 # production elimination/reroot code.
 L=torch.diag(block.weighted_degree)
 L[children,parents]-=block.conductance[children]
 L[parents,children]-=block.conductance[children]
 def dense_tree(x,ref,tau,strength):
  batch=len(x)
  diagonal=x.new_zeros(batch,n).index_add(1,block.query_nodes,tau)
  K=(op.INTERIOR_ABSORPTION*torch.eye(n)+torch.diag(block.source_mask)+strength*L)[None]+torch.diag_embed(diagonal)
  rhs=(block.source_mask[:,None]*ref)[None].expand(batch,-1,-1)
  rhs=rhs.index_add(1,block.query_nodes,tau[...,None]*x)
  z=torch.linalg.solve(K,rhs)
  return z[:,block.query_nodes],z,K,rhs
 original=(torch.randn(2,Q,4)*.3,torch.randn(n,4)*.2,1.1+torch.rand(2,Q)*.7,torch.tensor(.43))
 a=[v.clone().requires_grad_() for v in original];b=[v.clone().requires_grad_() for v in original]
 actual=op.tree_step_v1(*a,block)
 expected,z,K,rhs=dense_tree(*b)
 probe=torch.randn_like(actual)
 ga=torch.autograd.grad((actual*probe).sum(),a)
 gb=torch.autograd.grad((expected*probe).sum(),b)
 f_error=float((actual-expected).abs().max())
 g_errors=[float((u-v).abs().max()) for u,v in zip(ga,gb)]
 assert torch.allclose(actual,expected,atol=2e-6,rtol=3e-5)
 assert all(torch.allclose(u,v,atol=3e-6,rtol=4e-5) for u,v in zip(ga,gb))
 residual=float((K@z-rhs).abs().max())
 # Actual native Q rows are 0/1 in each copied observed tree, rather than
 # analytic350 points. Reference source masks have no Q anchoring.
 for copy_index in range(len(positions)):
  rows=block.query_nodes[copy_index*2:(copy_index+1)*2]
  copy_start=copy_index*13
  assert torch.equal(rows,torch.tensor([copy_start,copy_start+1]))
 assert not bool(block.source_mask[block.query_nodes].any())
 assert bank.metadata["older_proxy_placements_at_actual_sampling_nodes"]==6
 assert bank.metadata["younger_proxy_placements_at_analytic_350"]==6
 assert len(bank.reference_contrast)==39 # includes hold with no grid readout
 # Independent dense D / D^T dual updates.
 P=len(positions);D=torch.zeros(P-1,P)
 for i in range(P-1):D[i,i]=-1;D[i,i+1]=1
 def dense_tv(x,strength):
  flat=x.reshape(P,-1);dual=torch.zeros(P-1,flat.shape[1]);bound=strength*bank.tv_weights[:,None]
  for k in range(8):
   gradient=D@flat-(D@D.T)@dual
   dual=torch.clamp(dual+.25*gradient,min=-bound,max=bound)
  return (flat-D.T@dual).reshape_as(x)
 x=torch.randn(P,2,4);actual_x=x.clone().requires_grad_();dense_x=x.clone().requires_grad_()
 actual_l=torch.tensor(.12,requires_grad=True);dense_l=torch.tensor(.12,requires_grad=True)
 actual_tv=op.tv_step_v1(actual_x,bank.tv_weights,actual_l)
 expected_tv=dense_tv(dense_x,dense_l)
 test=torch.randn_like(actual_tv)
 gt_a=torch.autograd.grad((actual_tv*test).sum(),[actual_x,actual_l])
 gt_b=torch.autograd.grad((expected_tv*test).sum(),[dense_x,dense_l])
 tv_error=float((actual_tv-expected_tv).abs().max())
 tv_g_errors=[float((u-v).abs().max()) for u,v in zip(gt_a,gt_b)]
 assert torch.allclose(actual_tv,expected_tv,atol=2e-6,rtol=2e-5)
 assert all(torch.allclose(u,v,atol=2e-6,rtol=2e-5) for u,v in zip(gt_a,gt_b))
 two=torch.tensor([0.,1.]).reshape(2,1,1)
 two_result=op.tv_step_v1(two,torch.ones(1),torch.tensor(.1)).flatten()
 assert torch.allclose(two_result,torch.tensor([.1,.9]),atol=1e-7,rtol=0)
 constant=torch.full((P,2,4),.33)
 assert torch.equal(op.tv_step_v1(constant,bank.tv_weights,torch.tensor(.3)),constant)
 # Exact A/B call counts/order; same operators and fixed frozen precision.
 model=op.InterleavedTreeTVGNNV1();counts={arm:model.parameter_counts(arm) for arm in op.ARMS}
 assert counts["interleaved"]==counts["blocked"] and counts["interleaved"]["total"]==52
 frozen=(torch.randn(P,2,4)*.4).requires_grad_()
 assert torch.equal(model(bank,frozen,control="interleaved"),frozen.detach())
 with torch.no_grad():model.context_head.weight.normal_(0,.05)
 reference_model=copy.deepcopy(model)
 calls=[];orig_tree=model.tree_operator;orig_tv=op.tv_step_v1
 def mark_tree(self,*args,**kwargs):calls.append("A");return orig_tree(*args,**kwargs)
 def mark_tv(*args,**kwargs):calls.append("B");return orig_tv(*args,**kwargs)
 model.tree_operator=types.MethodType(mark_tree,model);op.tv_step_v1=mark_tv
 traces={}
 for arm in op.ARMS:
  calls.clear();model(bank,frozen,control=arm);traces[arm]=list(calls)
 op.tv_step_v1=orig_tv;model.tree_operator=orig_tree
 assert traces["interleaved"]==["A","B"]*3 and traces["blocked"]==["A"]*3+["B"]*3
 # checkpointed production graph vs uncheckpointed eval graph, same weights.
 checkpoint_errors={};gradient_errors={};all_gradients={}
 for arm in op.ARMS:
  model.train();model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
  checkpoint_result=model(bank,frozen,control=arm)
  loss_probe=torch.randn_like(checkpoint_result)
  (checkpoint_result*loss_probe).sum().backward()
  checkpoint_grad={name:p.grad.detach().clone() for name,p in model.named_parameters()}
  assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in checkpoint_grad.values())
  assert frozen.grad is None
  reference_model.eval();reference_model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
  ordinary_result=reference_model(bank,frozen,control=arm)
  (ordinary_result*loss_probe).sum().backward()
  checkpoint_errors[arm]=float((checkpoint_result-ordinary_result).abs().max())
  gradient_errors[arm]=max(float((checkpoint_grad[name]-p.grad).abs().max()) for name,p in reference_model.named_parameters())
  assert torch.allclose(checkpoint_result,ordinary_result,atol=1e-6,rtol=1e-5)
  assert gradient_errors[arm]<3e-6
  all_gradients[arm]={name:float(value.norm()) for name,value in checkpoint_grad.items()}
 r.update(status="PASS",tiny_packed_vertices=n,solve_forward_max_abs=f_error,
   solve_VJP_max_abs_by_x_reference_tau_strength=g_errors,solve_dense_residual_max_abs=residual,
   TV_forward_max_abs=tv_error,TV_VJP_max_abs_by_x_strength=tv_g_errors,
   two_point_TV_expected_smoothing=two_result.tolist(),TV_constant_preservation=True,
   source_actual_Q_placement=True,old_proxy_placements_at_actual_nodes=True,
   native_hold_without_readout_retained=True,operator_traces=traces,parameter_counts=counts,
   baseline_detached_no_gradient=True,zero_head_exact_frozen_skip=True,
   checkpoint_max_abs=checkpoint_errors,checkpoint_gradient_max_abs=gradient_errors,
   finite_parameter_gradient_norms=all_gradients,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
except Exception as e:
 r.update(status="FAILED",error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
if r["status"]!="PASS":raise SystemExit(1)
